title: The depth correspondence conditionally reduces to the Volume Conjecture at Borromean rings, the Whitehead link, and twist knots
html:
Conjecture. The depth correspondence conditionally reduces to the Volume Conjecture at Borromean rings, the Whitehead link, and twist knots

Conjecture (the depth correspondence conditionally reduces to Volume Conjecture at Borromean rings, Whitehead link, and twist knots).

Beyond the figure-8 row and the seven torus-knot rows, the depth correspondence (conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence) holds for additional Bring-embeddable hyperbolic-knot rows, conditional on Volume Conjecture discharges.

See Table 1. (Twist knot K_n has n half-twists; K_2 = 4_1 is the figure-8. Genus of K_n is 1 for all n, so all twist knots are Bring-embeddable.) For the Borromean rings and the Whitehead link the cell pairing and the Volume Conjecture discharge are explicit: over F = \mathbb{Q}(i) the dominant cell pairs by Markov trace with \mathrm{Li}_2^q(i), giving \mathrm{Vol}(L_{6a4}) = 8G and \mathrm{Vol}(L5a1) = 4G with G Catalan's constant, and van der Veen's coloured-Jones asymptotics discharge the Volume Conjecture at both links.

For any hyperbolic Bring-embeddable knot or link K with shape parameter in some number field F = \mathbb{Q}(z_K):

  • Step 1 (Bloch–Suslin) is unconditionally established for any F.
  • Step 2 (cell pairing computation) uses explicit Markov-trace and Lobachevsky geometry.
  • Step 3 (VC asymptotic) is knot-specific, requiring a published proof.

the depth correspondence at a depth-2 row conditionally reduces to the VC discharge for that knot. The rate-limiting step is the VC discharge per knot, not the Bloch–Suslin chain.

See Table 2 for Bring-embeddable hyperbolic knots awaiting VC discharge. Each would become a conditionally established row of the depth correspondence upon VC discharge.

Three additional rows of the depth correspondence are conditionally supported by the literature (Borromean, Whitehead; figure-8). Combined with the seven torus-knot rows, eleven total rows of the depth correspondence are supported by the literature. Every published VC discharge for a Bring-embeddable hyperbolic knot yields a conditional row of the depth correspondence.
